text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek takes the lead! The winner is 
Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaahhh!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (...Why... Why am I...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I recognized Creek-san's 
intensity as a threat and stayed on guard, 
why...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why couldn't I hold on to her...!?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Gh…… u-uuugh…………!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki bit her lip in bitter 
frustration. The instant I saw her turn 
her back to the grandstand, my feet were 
already racing toward the underground 
paddock tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried through the underground walkway 
out of breath. And there, standing frozen 
in the middle of it, was Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono... I am deeply ashamed to 
have shown such an unsightly display.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I ran so disgracefully that I have no 
excuses to offer...
choice_data_list:
That distance was always going to be 
tough.

That distance was always going to be 
tough, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The long distance of the Kikuka Sho was 
always a tough ask for her. Therefore, her 
defeat is nothing to be so pessimistic 
about, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No...! I was defeated in spirit. Even 
though I knew in my mind that I must not 
be overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Wha...?! Her presence has exploded...! An 
overwhelming aura covering heaven and 
earth...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Push back! Fire up your spirit! Burn it 
up!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Burn...! Urgh...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...I refuse to lose...! Win!! I want to 
win... and yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Only bewilderment spread. Writhing and 
struggling in the smoldering embers...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I pray that my legs will dig in and hold 
on, but dulled by fatigue, they only grow 
heavier...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Could there be... could there truly be 
such a disgrace...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I were consumed by the raging fire 
within, that would be one thing!! To be 
overwhelmed by sheer fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
…………I wanted so desperately to win, and 
I'm so frustrated right now, yet...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why did my spirit waver...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than the defeat itself, she seemed 
to harbor deep regrets about how she ran.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was true that even when facing Super 
Creek, Yaeno Muteki didn't show much 
competitive spirit. The reason that comes 
to mind is—
choice_data_list:
Is it because Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan 
aren't here...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The absence of the rivals she harbored 
such intense competitiveness toward. Up 
until now, Yaeno Muteki had been driven by 
a fierce desire to defeat the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That had fueled her obsession with 
victory. However, I told Yaeno Muteki that 
I couldn't feel any of that obsession from 
her today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
An obsession born from the desire to 
defeat Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san...

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!! Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter into 
pieces!! I will burn up this very life and 
carve proof that I existed right here and 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo!! *I'm* going to win the 
Derby! Meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(............As if I'd lose! Like hell 
I'll go down hereeee!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ORRAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I could run like I did 
today is because I was pulled forward by 
the sheer passion of you both.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to lose to that sheer 
tenacity... I wanted to burn my soul and 
shine brightly, just like the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed... My heart burned with the sole 
desire to defeat Chiyono O-san and 
Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Their obsession with the Derby was 
staggering, and I was swept along by that 
sheer tenacity..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ..."Obsession."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My feelings toward victory are not quite 
what one would call an "obsession"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. What Yaeno Muteki lacked was 
"obsession."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O harbored a fierce desire 
to stand side-by-side with Maruzensky, the 
idol she so deeply admired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan made a desperate resolution: 
to run even at the cost of her life, 
simply to etch proof of her existence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding their own "obsessions" close to 
heart, they turned them into a fierce 
drive for victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A feeling that surpasses "wanting to win." 
The "obsession" of "refusing to yield" is 
what ultimately decides the match in the 
very final moments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Obsession" is not something that can be 
given by others. She must find it for 
herself—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Without relying on Chiyono O-san and the 
others, I must find that "obsession" 
within myself...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list:
There's no need to rush. You'll get 
stronger, I promise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Obsession” is a power that creates 
something extra. I explain that she just 
needs to strengthen her physicality enough 
to win even with little obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will continue to dedicate 
myself to my training as always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether Yaeno Muteki can foster a fierce 
tenacity—for now, there is nothing to do 
but leave it to her and watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *Exhale*!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Here you go.
choice_data_list: What do you think about the "Osaka Hai"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having watched the Kikuka-sho, I told 
Yaeno Muteki that her strengths shone far 
better in medium distances than in long 
distances.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why you're aiming for the 
spring medium-distance GⅠ, the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If it is a GⅠ, I am sure to encounter 
formidable opponents. I have no 
objections.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next goal was decided: the 
Osaka Hai!
